name: Brand95 Blueprint (owned DTC + B2B brands)
mission: Take a product idea to a €500k+ ARR brand with a brand manager, one stage-gate at a time. Evidence before expansion.
portfolio_rule: One active build, one validation project. Warn when the portfolio exceeds this.

stages.name: 0 · Intake
stages.purpose: Convert a loose idea into a structured brand candidate.

stages.name: 1 · Discover
stages.purpose: Determine whether the opportunity deserves validation.
outputs: Opportunity memo: proceed / revise / park / reject

criteria.label: No fatal regulatory or supply-chain blocker

stages.name: 2 · Validate
stages.purpose: Behavioral evidence before inventory or build cost.

criteria.label: 100 qualified signups OR 25 paid reservations OR 10 retailer EOIs with 3 written opening-order indications

stages.name: 3 · Build brand
stages.purpose: A recognizable, ownable, commercially usable brand system.

criteria.label: Understood in 5 seconds, recognizable from 5 metres
Production-ready files exist or are assigned

stages.name: 4 · Hero product
stages.purpose: Finalize one product worth building the brand around.

criteria.label: Landed cost verified (freight, duties, packaging, fees, returns, fulfilment)
Minimum viable order supported by validation evidence

stages.name: 5 · Buying experience
stages.purpose: Make the brand genuinely purchasable and credible.

stages.name: 6 · Launch · first 100 customers
stages.purpose: Prove strangers will buy and find repeatable demand signals.

stages.name: 7 · Retail validation
stages.purpose: Establish retail as a measurable channel.

stages.name: 8 · Repeatable growth
stages.purpose: Turn isolated wins into a predictable engine.

criteria.label: At least one channel is repeatable
Positive contribution margin in base case

stages.name: 9 · Brand ecosystem
stages.purpose: Expand assortment only after the hero is validated.

criteria.label: 3 commercially viable SKUs or a clearly profitable focused assortment
Runs 4 weeks without founder operational intervention
Key processes have owners and documented fallbacks

kill_rules: Validation gate not met after two experiment cycles → park.
Gross margin below 50% D2C or 35% wholesale in base case → revise product or kill.
A second brand cannot enter Build while one is already in Build → queue it.
